# Wave B — loading boundaries, validation reads and operating documentation

Approved 2026-10-08; T-0805; branch `codex/wave-b-loading-reads`; entry master
`ed1e1b8fe8c6963758063def22dbc424446d0b9d`. Source implementation, backend/web/repo/docs verification and graph refresh are complete;
root clean full-native builds/suites, root focused floor tests and qualified ordinary-launch evidence are complete. Final report/ticket publication checks and exact-head CI remain pending at this record-publication cutoff.

## Delivery and limits

One wave and one PR, with one commit for each of W02, W03, W06, W08, B004,
MOB-REL-01 and D01. The three previously approved B010 merge-closure Markdown
records travel in the work-record commit. This wave changes loading and validation
work while preserving existing product rules, guards, HTTP/DTO contracts and schema.
Native Swift isolation/closure type annotations change within existing classes.

No Waves C–F, broader Board queries, delivery policy, API/schema work, maintained
framework/type/harness/gate, deployment, DEV reset/load, providers, distribution or
physical-device claim. Scratch tools and raw evidence remain outside the tree.
The immutable original audit and primary owner settings are preserved; no phone
Page edits were requested or performed. Xcode catalog identity is checked throughout.
Mike subsequently authorized merging completed Wave B after actual local/review/exact-head
CI closure, then continuing the next two roadmap waves separately. The direct instruction
is retained in scratch raw/owner-authorization-merge-b-then-c-d.json.

## Measurements

Five observations per measured cohort; median and nearest-rank p90, which equals
the maximum at n=5. Sequential local arms are lab comparisons. Full raw observations,
metafiles, fixture qualifications, screenshots, excluded attempts and command ledger:
`/Users/michael/.codex/scratchpads/cleansia-wave-b-2026-10-08`.

Web serving uses the same pinned Node 22.23.3 localhost compression/proxy profile,
unchanged ed1 Partner/Admin API products, frozen synthetic reference data, locale and
browser settings. Lighthouse mobile simulation and physical CDP waterfall metrics
have distinct definitions. Emitted gzip estimates use Node gzipSync(level 9) for all
checkpoints; earlier Python estimates are retained but superseded. Actual transferred
bytes are recorded separately. Dashboard EndDate advances naturally; calendar range
and all three analytics response hashes are unchanged across its ten observations.
There is no fixed-clock or identical-millisecond-query claim.

{"ledgerOrdinal": 1036, "record": {"label": "root-b-retired-support-cache-size-read-001", "command": ["python3", "-E", "-c", "import pathlib,os,stat,time,json\nb=pathlib.Path(\"/Users/michael/.codex/scratchpads/cleansia-wave-b-2026-10-08\")\nstart=time.monotonic()\nfor name in ['ModuleCache.noindex','Index.noindex','CompilationCache.noindex']:\n root=b/'artifacts/ios/root-latest-derived-01'/name\n assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink() and root.resolve()==root\n rows={'regularFiles':0,'directories':0,'symlinks':0,'logicalBytes':0}\n for directory,dirs,files in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):\n  assert time.monotonic()-start<30\n  for entry in dirs+files:\n   p=pathlib.Path(directory)/entry;s=p.lstat()\n   assert s.st_dev==root.stat().st_dev\n   if stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode):rows['regularFiles']+=1;rows['logicalBytes']+=s.st_size\n   elif stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):rows['directories']+=1\n   elif stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode):rows['symlinks']+=1\n   else:raise RuntimeError('Special file')\n   assert sum(rows[k] for k in ['regularFiles','directories','symlinks'])<=200000\n print(json.dumps({'target':str(root),'metadataOnly':True,**rows}))\n"], "cwd": "/Users/michael/.codex/scratchpads/cleansia-wave-b-2026-10-08", "start_utc": "2026-10-09T04:26:07.206112+00:00", "elapsed_s": 0.39621304208412766, "exit_code": 0, "log": "/Users/michael/.codex/scratchpads/cleansia-wave-b-2026-10-08/logs/root-b-retired-support-cache-size-read-001.log"}, "classification": "completed recorded command; log binding follows", "referenceSha256": "38808df3a53cbae6df8a0f15528ecd8d0549ae0d016ce0cb5956e76374afabb3"}
